    displayName="Continuum Construct"

    versionRange="${minecraft_range}"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"

[[dependencies.tconstruct]]
    modId="mantle"
    type="required"
    versionRange="${mantle_range}"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"

[[dependencies.tconstruct]]

    type="optional"
    versionRange="${jei_range}"
    ordering="NONE"

    type="optional"
    versionRange="${json_things_range}"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"

[[dependencies.tconstruct]]

    type="optional"
    versionRange="${apotheosis_range}"
    ordering="AFTER"
    side="BOTH"

[[dependencies.tconstruct]]
    modId="enderio"
    type="optional"
    ordering="AFTER"
    side="BOTH"

[[dependencies.tconstruct]]
    modId="athena"

    versionRange="${jade_range}"
    ordering="NONE"
    side="BOTH"
